Title: Install Azure Service Operator via Visual Studio Code extension for AKS

Body.Content:
We are announcing the new version of the Visual Studio Code extension for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). This Visual Studio Code extension enables developers to install Azure Service Operator during their development workflow.

The new Visual Studio extension for AKS significantly reduces the number of steps required for installing Azure Service Operator on AKS clusters. Developers can now quickly install Azure Service Operator for their AKS clusters by passing on Service Principal credentials. Once installed, Azure Service Operator helps you provision Azure resources and connect your applications to them from within Kubernetes.

Learn more.
